topic.title: King Charles III England Coast Path / Coastal Margin / Access Rights
topic.source_contract: route and coastal-margin identity, approved stretch and opening status, alignment, access rights, excepted land, restrictions, public rights of way, development effects, Natural England variation report, highway authority actions, construction safety, reinstatement and access monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A proposed coast-path stretch is not an open access route.
Mapped coastal margin is not proof that every parcel carries access rights.
Excepted-land status is not inferred without exact land-use evidence.
A temporary restriction is not a permanent route change.
Planning permission is not approval of a coast-path variation.
Construction signage is not reinstated public access.
A route reopening notice is not measured accessibility performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact route status, rights, decision, reinstatement and monitoring evidence.
